body:
Ravi: Need a fast turnaround case for Velocity (short blog + 30s clip + tweet). Customer can record this week.
Clara: I can take lead. Prefer Wed 11-11:30am PT or Thu 4-4:30pm PT.
Mei: Wed 11 works for customer. They want the interview questions ahead.
Clara: Draft Qs: 1) What was the pain? 2) What measurable impact did Redwood provide? 3) One-line quote for social. Redlines welcome.
Jon: Sales ask: include an SFDC tag "Case: VELOCITY-2026" and add a 15-min demo CTA in the publish flow. Also route EU clicks to EU SDRs.
Priya: Legal: need a one-line usage release and logo permission. If they include percentages, require explicit signed approval email.
Ravi: I'll add the release checkbox to the prep doc and export a PDF after approval. Action: Ravi to send approval email after recording.
Clara: Uploaded recording guide + sample prompts: https://drive.redwood/velocity/guide.md
Mei: Customer suggested this quote tweak: "Reduced tail latency by ~60% and cut token spend in half". Can we keep numbers?
Priya: Please get explicit sign-off on numbers. If they won't sign, change to "significantly reduced latency and token costs."
Clara: Noted. I'll include both variants in the doc and ask for a one-line reply approving copy and logo use.
AssetBot: Calendar event created: Velocity case recording Wed 11:00-11:30 PT (Clara, Ravi, Mei, Customer Rep).
Jon: Timeline: record Wed, edit Thu morning, legal approval Thu afternoon, publish next Mon. Is that okay?
Clara: Yes. I'll deliver the 30s clip Thu AM and drop assets to /marketing/releases/velocity.
Ravi: Priya please cc legal on the approval email so we can archive to /marketing/legal/releases/velocity-case.pdf.
Priya: Will do. Also send me the final transcript so I can verify the quote text.
Clara: Quick ask 1: do we want a short landing snippet or just blog + tweet?
Ravi: Short landing snippet plus blog. One paragraph, hero quote, screenshot. No long form.
Mei: I'll provide screenshot and a metrics callout after recording.
Clara: Recap actions: 1) Record Wed 11; 2) Ravi sends approval email after recording; 3) Customer replies with signed approval (numbers or redacted); 4) Priya stores approval and clears copy; 5) Clara produces clip + assets; 6) Jon ensures SFDC tag & routing; 7) Publish Mon.
Clara: I'll post final links here once assets are uploaded.
Ravi: Thanks team 680"
